herenow.apiKey: YOUR_HERENOW_API_KEY (or set HERENOW_API_KEY in the environment instead)

site.siteUrl: OPTIONAL: https://YOUR-SITE-SLUG.example (defaults to the here.now slug URL)

submissions.approverNote: Who approves listings (placeholder: the store owner). Change here or override in config.local.json.

reservedIds.note: Reserved for the store owner's own apps.

submissions.stateFile: OPTIONAL: a path outside the repo (default: ~/.aipp-store/submissions-state.json)
submissions.privateTermsNote: Put private names and terms to block (family words, real usernames, league or pet names) in config.local.json only, never here.
submissions.frontOfficeEmailNote: Public mailto target for Request an edit links. While "TBD" (or not a valid address), app pages show the app ID and a "coming soon" note instead of a link.
submissions.reservedContactsNote: Email on file for the reserved IDs (the store owner's own apps). Private: set real values only in config.local.json.
submissions.draftsDir: OPTIONAL: a private folder outside the repo (default: ~/.aipp-store/drafts)
submissions.switchesNote: Owner switches, all OFF. sendDraftsApproved: lets capped confirmation drafts be marked sendable (each send still needs its own approval card). emergencyManifestPreapproved: standing OK for Review & Release to publish tools/manifest-disabled.json on a quarantine or flood P0. cleanupDeletesApproved: lets tools/submissions-cleanup.mjs --apply delete records. Turn on only in config.local.json, on the owner's decision.
